_description: Procedural UI Guide benchmark — labeled multi-step scenario. One scenario = one user goal traced through N screen states with ground-truth expected behavior at each step.

_field_docs.manual_id: Manual ChromaDB collection id this scenario is grounded in
_field_docs.category: Domain tag — e.g. import, visualization, attribute, modeling, file_management, settings
_field_docs.difficulty: easy / medium / hard — judged by # of steps, branching, error-recovery needs
_field_docs.language: ko / en — language the AI should respond in
_field_docs.goal: Full user-typed goal text (verbatim from typical user input, including specifics like paths/names)
_field_docs.steps: Ordered list of expected screen states + ground-truth actions
_field_docs.steps[].visual_state_gt: Ground-truth UI extraction the AI SHOULD produce — used to score visual recognition fidelity
_field_docs.steps[].expected_action_text_pattern: Regex(case-insensitive) the AI response is expected to match — at least one capture group naming the target button/menu
_field_docs.steps[].expected_action_keywords: List of keyword strings the AI response should contain (lenient alt to regex)
_field_docs.steps[].expected_workflow_node: Workflow node id we expect localizer to pick (null = any valid match acceptable)
_field_docs.steps[].allowed_alternatives: Other acceptable response patterns (alternate menu paths etc.)
_field_docs.steps[].is_error_recovery_test: true if this step is intentionally a wrong-state test — expects AI to detect+recover
_field_docs.completion: How to detect successful goal completion
_field_docs.completion.expected_done_sentinel: true if AI is expected to emit Done/완료 after this scenario
